content.title: Can you predict the #Stanley Cup Playoffs?
content.text: Brackets open: Coming soonPredict the 2026 Stanley Cup® ChampionPre-Register today!The official 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs seeds have not been finalized yet. Brackets will open once all 16 Playoffs seeds for the 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs have been set.NO PURCHASE NECESSARY. VOID WHERE PROHIBITED. Open to legal residents of the 50 US/DC, CA, BG, CN, CZ, DK, FI, DE, NL, NO, SK, SE, CH or the UK (excluding Northern Ireland), age of majority+ with an NHL.com account and NHL GameZone user profile. The Bracket Challenge Promotion begins immediately after all spots in the 2026 Stanley Cup® Playoffs (the “Playoffs”) have been determined and all seedings have been established but in any event, barring any unforeseen scheduling changes, no later than 2:00:00 a.m. ET on April 17, 2026. Second Chance Bracket Promotion begins following the conclusion of the First Round of the Playoffs and once matchups for the Second Round of the Playoffs have been set (or as otherwise updated at nhl.com/bracket). Ends at the conclusion of the last game of the Playoffs. 1 Grand Prize: a 2026/2027 NHL event package and an Adventure Chrono 41mm NHL Limited Edition watch from Norqain; ARV of Grand Prize: up to $10,490 USD. 1 Second Chance Bracket Prize: a $1,000 USD NHL Shop gift code. Skill test applies for CA residents. Sponsor: NHL Interactive CyberEnterprises, LLC.
